title: Enochian tale found in Dead Sea Scroll manuscripts

tellings.quote: the Enochian tale is attested not just in Enoch >> but in several Dead Sea Scroll manuscripts >> including the book of giants

plain: The story told in the Book of Enoch, an ancient Jewish text that most Bibles leave out, is not found only in that book, according to the researcher Tim Alberino. He tells Michels, without naming a source, that the tale 'is attested not just in Enoch but in several Dead Sea Scroll manuscripts,' the ancient scrolls found at Qumran, 'including the Book of Giants,' and he also points to the Book of Jubilees and the Genesis Apocryphon. His point is that the story was old and widely copied, not a one-off.
